eleven_creative.title: ElevenCreative
eleven_creative.target_audience: Individual creators, YouTubers, podcasters, marketing agencies, video producers
core_features: Studio timeline editor for video, narration, music, and captions
Flows node-based visual pipeline on infinite canvas (A/B testing, multi-lingual batch generation)
Text to Speech v3 with Expressive Mode & Audio Tags ([laughs], [whispers], [sighs])
Commercial Music Generation (cleared for broad commercial use across multiple genres)
Sound Effects & Foley from text descriptions
AI Dubbing in 100+ languages preserving original speaker timbre and cadence
GenFM AI-generated podcasts and direct audiobook production

eleven_agents.title: ElevenAgents
eleven_agents.target_audience: Small businesses, solo operators, clinics, legal firms, real estate, customer support teams
core_features: 24/7 AI Receptionist answering inbound calls and booking appointments directly
No-code configuration in under 15 minutes using company knowledge base (PDF, URLs, FAQs)
Integrations with Google Calendar, Outlook, Calendly, WhatsApp, Make, Zapier, Salesforce, Zendesk
Expressive Mode allowing de-escalation of difficult callers with empathetic tone
Multi-lingual support across 70+ languages without human agent fatigue

eleven_api.title: ElevenAPI
eleven_api.target_audience: Developers, AI startups, vibe-coders (Cursor, Lovable, Replit, v0), enterprise engineering
core_features: Sub-500ms streaming responses for real-time conversational applications
Native SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Flutter, Swift, and Kotlin
Scribe Speech-to-Text with 20-50x real-time transcription across 99 languages
SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR compliant with zero-retention mode
